title: CoolGui
script:
-- IX Coolgui v6.2 - Smooth & Full Animation Edition
-- Features: 30s Fullscreen Loading with Sound & Fade, Smooth Tween Open/Close, Godmode, Anti Fling, HD Fly, Executor, & IY.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Safe GUI Container for Delta Executor
local parentUI = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
if not parentUI then return end

-- Cleanup script lama
if parentUI:FindFirstChild("IXLoading") then parentUI.IXLoading:Destroy() end
if parentUI:FindFirstChild("IXCoolguiHub") then parentUI.IXCoolguiHub:Destroy() end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG DEFAULT
---------------------------------------------------------
local Config = {
    WalkSpeed = 16,
    JumpPower = 50,
    SlowFall = false,
    InfJump = false,
    Godmode = false,
    AntiFling = false,
    Fly = false,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    Noclip = false,
    UltraInstinct = false,
    UI_Range = 15,
    ESP_Chams = false,
    ESP_Name = false,
    ESP_Health = false,
    ESP_Distance = false,
    Fullbright = false,
    NightVision = false
}

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. 30 DETIK FULLSCREEN LOADING (DENGAN ANIMASI & SOUND)
---------------------------------------------------------
local LoadingGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LoadingGui.Name = "IXLoading"
LoadingGui.Parent = parentUI
LoadingGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
LoadingGui.DisplayOrder = 999999

local LoadFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LoadFrame.Parent = LoadingGui
LoadFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 4, 4)
LoadFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
LoadFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
LoadFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

-- Play Loading Audio (ID: 9048376021)
local LoadSound = Instance.new("Sound")
pcall(function()
    LoadSound.Parent = SoundService
    LoadSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9048376021"
    LoadSound.Volume = 1
    LoadSound.Looped = true
    LoadSound:Play()
end)

local LoadTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadTitle.Parent = LoadFrame
LoadTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -220, 0.35, -50)
LoadTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 440, 0, 60)
LoadTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
LoadTitle.Text = "IX COOLGUI ELITE"
LoadTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
LoadTitle.TextSize = 40
LoadTitle.TextTransparency = 1

local LoadSub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadSub.Parent = LoadFrame
LoadSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadSub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -220, 0.35, 15)
LoadSub.Size = UDim2.new(0, 440, 0, 30)
LoadSub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
LoadSub.Text = "Memuat Asset, Engine & Konfigurasi (30s)..."
LoadSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 90, 90)
LoadSub.TextSize = 14
LoadSub.TextTransparency = 1

local BarBg = Instance.new("Frame")
BarBg.Parent = LoadFrame
BarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 10, 10)
BarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -175, 0.48, 40)
BarBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 12)
BarBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local BarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") BarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0) BarCorner.Parent = BarBg

local BarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
BarFill.Parent = BarBg
BarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
BarFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local FillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") FillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0) FillCorner.Parent = BarFill

-- Animasi Fade-In Loading Screen
TweenService:Create(LoadFrame, TweenInfo.new(1), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
TweenService:Create(LoadTitle, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
TweenService:Create(LoadSub, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
TweenService:Create(BarBg, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
TweenService:Create(BarFill, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()

-- Animasi Teks Titik Berjalan
task.spawn(function()
    local dots = {"", ".", "..", "..."}
    while LoadingGui.Parent do
        for _, d in ipairs(dots) do
            if not LoadingGui.Parent then break end
            LoadSub.Text = "Memuat Asset, Engine & Konfigurasi (30s)" .. d
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
    end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- MAIN GUI SETUP (DENGAN ANIMASI BUKA/TUTUP HALUS)
---------------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "IXCoolguiHub"
ScreenGui.Parent = parentUI
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Enabled = false

local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
ToggleBtn.Parent = ScreenGui
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 20, 20)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, -25)
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
ToggleBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://6023426915"
ToggleBtn.Active = true
ToggleBtn.Draggable = true

local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn
local ToggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") ToggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) ToggleStroke.Thickness = 2 ToggleStroke.Parent = ToggleBtn

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 8, 8)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -170)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 340)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.Visible = false

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 30, 30) MainStroke.Thickness = 2 MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Background Image (ID: 5670869502)
local BgImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
BgImage.Parent = MainFrame
BgImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BgImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
BgImage.Image = "rbxassetid://5670869502"
BgImage.ImageTransparency = 0.70
BgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch

local isOpen = false
ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isOpen = not isOpen
    if isOpen then
        MainFrame.Visible = true
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 340)}):Play()
    else
        local tw = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)})
        tw:Play()
        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not isOpen then MainFrame.Visible = false end
        end)
    end
end)

local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 10, 10)
TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
local TopCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") TopCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) TopCorner.Parent = TopBar

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Parent = TopBar
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 1, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Text = "IX COOLGUI v6.2 - MASTER EDITION"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
Title.TextSize = 13
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, -11)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Text = "X"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 12
local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isOpen = false
    local tw = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)})
    tw:Play()
    tw.Completed:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = false end)
end)

local Container = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
Container.Parent = MainFrame
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 48)
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -58)
Container.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2200)
Container.ScrollBarThickness = 4
Container.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 30, 30)

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = Container
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Helper UI Functions
local function addLabel(text)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Parent = Container
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.Text = "--- " .. text .. " ---"
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    return lbl
end

local function addToggle(text, configKey)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = Container
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config[configKey] and Color3.fromRGB(150, 25, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(35, 15, 15)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.Text = text .. " : " .. (Config[configKey] and "ON" or "OFF")
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) corner.Parent = btn
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Config[configKey] = not Config[configKey]
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config[configKey] and Color3.fromRGB(150, 25, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(35, 15, 15)
        btn.Text = text .. " : " .. (Config[configKey] and "ON" or "OFF")
    end)
    return btn
end

local function addInput(placeholder, callback)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Parent = Container
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 12, 12)
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 100)
    box.Text = ""
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    box.TextSize = 12
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) corner.Parent = box
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 30) stroke.Thickness = 1 stroke.Parent = box
    
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then callback(box.Text) end
    end)
    return box
end

local function addButton(text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = Container
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 25, 25)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
    btn.TextSize = 12
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) corner.Parent = btn
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return btn
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- MENU FITUR COMPONENT
---------------------------------------------------------
addLabel("PLAYER & MOVEMENT")
addInput("Set Speed (Default 16)", function(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n then Config.WalkSpeed = n end end)
addInput("Set Jump Power (Default 50)", function(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n then Config.JumpPower = n end end)
addToggle("Slow Falling", "SlowFall")
addToggle("Infinite Jump", "InfJump")
addToggle("Godmode (Anti Mati)", "Godmode")
addToggle("Anti Fling", "AntiFling")
addToggle("Fly Mode (HD Admin)", "Fly")
addInput("Set Fly Speed (Default 50)", function(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n then Config.FlySpeed = n end end)
addToggle("Noclip", "Noclip")

addLabel("EXECUTOR & SCRIPTS")
local ExecBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
ExecBox.Parent = Container
ExecBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 10)
ExecBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
ExecBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
ExecBox.MultiLine = true
ExecBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
ExecBox.PlaceholderText = "-- Ketik Script Luau di sini..."
ExecBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 100)
ExecBox.Text = ""
ExecBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ExecBox.TextSize = 12
local execCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") execCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) execCorner.Parent = ExecBox

addButton("Execute Custom Script", function()
    pcall(function() loadstring(ExecBox.Text)() end)
end)

addButton("Execute Infinite Yield", function()
    pcall(function() loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source'))() end)
end)

addLabel("COMBAT & UTILS")
addToggle("Ultra Instinct (Auto Dodge + Emote/Audio)", "UltraInstinct")
addInput("Set UI Range (Default 15)", function(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n then Config.UI_Range = n end end)

addButton("Give F3X Tool [ID: 142785488]", function()
    pcall(function()
        local assets = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://142785488")
        for _, asset in pairs(assets) do
            asset.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
        end
    end)
end)

addLabel("SPECTATE PLAYER")
addInput("Ketik Nama Player untuk Dispectate", function(name)
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name:lower() then
            if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                Camera.CameraSubject = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                break
            end
        end
    end
end)
addButton("Exit Spectate (Kembali ke Asli)", function()
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
end)

addLabel("VISUALS & ESP")
addToggle("ESP Chams", "ESP_Chams")
addToggle("ESP Name", "ESP_Name")
addToggle("ESP Health", "ESP_Health")
addToggle("ESP Distance", "ESP_Distance")

addLabel("WORLD & LIGHTING")
addToggle("Fullbright", "Fullbright")
addToggle("Night Vision", "NightVision")
addInput("Set Brightness (Contoh: 3)", function(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n then Lighting.Brightness = n end end)
addInput("Set Fog (Contoh: 500)", function(v)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    if n then Lighting.FogEnd = n Lighting.FogStart = 0 Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 20, 20) end
end)
addInput("Set Skybox ID", function(v)
    local id = tonumber(v)
    if id then
        for _, s in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Sky") then s:Destroy() end end
        local sky = Instance.new("Sky") sky.Parent = Lighting local idStr = "rbxassetid://" .. id
        sky.SkyboxBk = idStr sky.SkyboxDn = idStr sky.SkyboxFt = idStr sky.SkyboxLf = idStr sky.SkyboxRt = idStr sky.SkyboxUp = idStr
    end
end)
addButton("Remove Map Textures (Lag Fix)", function()
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        elseif obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then obj:Destroy() end
    end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 30 DETIK LOADING COMPLETION DENGAN FADE HALUS
---------------------------------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
    local duration = 30 -- Durasi 30 detik pemuatan asset
    local start = tick()
    while tick() - start < duration do
        local pct = (tick() - start) / duration
        BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
    BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    task.wait(0.5)
    
    -- Fade out loading audio & screen
    pcall(function() TweenService:Create(LoadSound, TweenInfo.new(1), {Volume = 0}):Play() end)
    TweenService:Create(LoadFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(LoadTitle, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(LoadSub, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(BarBg, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(BarFill, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.8)
    
    pcall(function() LoadSound:Stop() LoadSound:Destroy() end)
    LoadingGui:Destroy()
    
    -- Tampilkan GUI Utama dengan Animasi Pop-up Mulia
    ScreenGui.Enabled = true
    MainFrame.Visible = true
    isOpen = true
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 340)}):Play()
end)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- CORE RUNSERVICE LOOPS (GODMODE, ANTI FLING, HD FLY, UI)
---------------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if Config.InfJump then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
            if Config.JumpPower ~= 50 then
                hum.UseJumpPower = true
                hum.JumpPower = Config.JumpPower
            end
            if Config.Godmode then hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end
        end
        
        if Config.AntiFling and hrp then
            if hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 250 or hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 250 then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end
        
        if Config.SlowFall and hrp and hrp.Velocity.Y < -5 then
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(hrp.Velocity.X, -5, hrp.Velocity.Z)
        end
        
        if Config.Noclip then
            for _, part in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if Config.Fullbright then
        Lighting.Brightness = 2 Lighting.ClockTime = 14 Lighting.FogEnd = 100000 Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end
    if Config.NightVision then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
    end
end)

-- HD Admin Style Fly Mechanic
local flyGyro, flyVel
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    if Config.Fly and hrp and hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        if not hrp:FindFirstChild("IXAdminGyro") then
            flyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            flyGyro.Name = "IXAdminGyro"
            flyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            flyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
            flyGyro.Parent = hrp
            
            flyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            flyVel.Name = "IXAdminVel"
            flyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            flyVel.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            flyVel.Parent = hrp
        end
        
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        local speed = Config.FlySpeed
        local vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            vel = Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (moveDir.Z < 0 and speed or -speed) + Camera.CFrame.RightVector * (moveDir.X > 0 and speed or -speed)
        end
        flyVel.Velocity = vel
        flyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    else
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
        if hrp then
            if hrp:FindFirstChild("IXAdminGyro") then hrp.IXAdminGyro:Destroy() end
            if hrp:FindFirstChild("IXAdminVel") then hrp.IXAdminVel:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end)

-- Ultra Instinct Proximity Dodge with Emote Audio IDs: 129561737395908 & 132521221880216
local lastDodge = 0
local instinctAudioIds = {"rbxassetid://129561737395908", "rbxassetid://132521221880216"}

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Config.UltraInstinct and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        
        if tick() - lastDodge > 0.8 then
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local targetHrp = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    if (targetHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= Config.UI_Range then
                        lastDodge = tick()
                        
                        pcall(function()
                            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
                            snd.Parent = hrp
                            snd.SoundId = instinctAudioIds[math.random(1, #instinctAudioIds)]
                            snd.Volume = 1.2
                            snd:Play()
                            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(snd, 3)
                        end)
                        
                        local dodgePos = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-18, 18), 0, math.random(-18, 18))
                        TweenService:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {CFrame = dodgePos}):Play()
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ESP Chams & Text Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local char = p.Character
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            local hl = char:FindFirstChild("IXChams")
            if Config.ESP_Chams then
                if not hl then
                    hl = Instance.new("Highlight") hl.Name = "IXChams" hl.Parent = char hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                end
            elseif hl then hl:Destroy() end
            
            local bgui = hrp:FindFirstChild("IXESP")
            if (Config.ESP_Name or Config.ESP_Health or Config.ESP_Distance) then
                if not bgui then
                    bgui = Instance.new("BillboardGui") bgui.Name = "IXESP" bgui.Parent = hrp bgui.AlwaysOnTop = true bgui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50) bgui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel") txt.Name = "ESPLabel" txt.Parent = bgui txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1 txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) txt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) txt.TextSize = 12
                end
                
                local dist = math.floor((LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0)
                local hp = hum and math.floor(hum.Health) or 0
                
                local info = ""
                if Config.ESP_Name then info = info .. p.Name .. " " end
                if Config.ESP_Health then info = info .. "[" .. hp .. " HP] " end
                if Config.ESP_Distance then info = info .. "(" .. dist .. "m)" end
